A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same R3DM research work. All 21 pages, including figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–C, are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v4 reports original SMAC and SMACv2 experiments, learning curves, qualitative policy analysis, and ablations in Section 5 and Figures 2–5.

after.justification: v5 retains the original SMAC and SMACv2 experiments, qualitative analysis, and ablation results in Section 5 and Figures 2–5.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Appendices B–C retain the same role-learning objective, contrastive learning, policy and dynamics intrinsic rewards, model components, and algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same six SMAC scenarios and six SMACv2 scenarios. Updating the SMACv2 citation year does not change benchmark coverage.

E2.justification: Figures 2–3 retain ACORM, GoMARL, CIA, CDS, QMIX, and EMC as comparators. The qualitative comparison and ablation variants also remain unchanged; the EOI citation edit introduces no evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: The environment version, training budgets, metrics, model configurations, and evaluation procedures are unchanged. Appendix B retains evaluation using 32 episodes every 5,000 updates and the same settings in Tables 1–4.

E4.justification: Sections 5.3–5.4 and Figures 4–5 retain the same policy and role-embedding case study and ablations of imagination horizon, role cardinality, and contrastive learning.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same five random seeds and mean curves with standard-deviation shading. The statistical qualifications accompanying the ablations are unchanged.

E6.justification: The win-rate and return curves in Figures 2–3, qualitative findings in Figure 4, and ablation outcomes in Figure 5 are identical. No result entries, numerical outcomes, or reported trends change.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, Theorems 4.1–4.3, proofs in Appendix A, and intrinsic-reward derivations in Appendix B.5 are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: connecting roles with future behavior through dynamics-based intrinsic rewards and reporting win-rate improvements of up to 20%.

C2.justification: Interpretations of coordination, exploration, and ablation outcomes are unchanged. Section 6 retains the limitations concerning a predefined role count and local dynamics models that omit other agents' actions and roles.

D1.justification: Appendix B's implementation details and hyperparameter tables, Appendix C's pseudocode, and the R3DM and DreamerV3 code-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v5 removes the separate Jiang and Lu (2021b) entry, 'Emergent individuality in multi-agent systems through observation-identity mapping,' and redirects Section 3.2's EOI citation to the retained 'The emergence of individuality.' This is a limited citation reassignment; the discussion and research positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Localized edits update citation years and suffixes, add a comma in Section 3.2, and revise bibliographic metadata for SePS, SMACv2, ROMA, and RODE. Section organization and substantive prose are unchanged.

P2.justification: The bibliography edits reflow entries across columns and pages 9–11. Figures 1–5, Tables 1–4, equation layouts, and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: Consolidating EOI attribution and adding publication details, including SMACv2's page range and ROMA's proceedings information, modestly improve citation clarity and reference completeness. The methods, empirical evidence, theory, and appendices remain unchanged, so the overall gain is limited to scholarly documentation.
